Thanks Marissa — Thu Dec 3 works; I see the invite (moved on our side). A few quick asks for the agenda so we can prep the right stakeholders: 

1) Audit logs: we need examples of the raw events you capture, retention export options, and whether we can stream copies to our SIEM (Splunk).
2) Encryption/KMS: can you outline BYOK flow for Dedicated and for Private (VPC) deployments and what metadata Redwood stores unencrypted?
3) SSO: we will want a clear sequence for IdP-initiated flows and just-in-time account provisioning details.

If you can push the updated evidence matrix with columns for owner, path to artifact, and sample file names that would be ideal. Otherwise we're good for the call.

See you Thu.
